recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core edit is needed for FHIR-8656; any future correction to the underlying v2-0136 or v2-0532 definitions should be handled through the external terminology/THO source process.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core request to restore HL7 v2 table 0136 or create a Y/N value set based on v2 table 0532, depending on Vocabulary guidance, because Observation guidance needed a coded yes/no alternative for result values that are not truly Boolean.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 6892. The corresponding git commit 3886233da6ae updated source/v2/v2.ini and source/v2/v2oids.txt, restoring table 0136 in the v2 table/OID list and mapping 0532 as a value set over 0136 plus v3 NullFlavor. The related yes/no/don't know example ValueSet had been added earlier in e94679451e and survived later URL and ValueSet syntax migrations.
additional_context: Core later externalized v2/UTG terminology content: 5c0494aacf removed source/v2 and other UTG terminology source from the core build. Current THO exposes ValueSet/v2-0136 over CodeSystem/v2-0532, while CodeSystem/v2-0136 is absent. Current core source imports ValueSet/v2-0136 in valueset-example-yesnodontknow, expands Y and N from CodeSystem/v2-0532, and points Observation value[x] guidance at ValueSet/v2-0136. FHIR-37453, already audited on the combined branch, later reconciled the missing CodeSystem/v2-0136 problem; FHIR-27788 confirms the example value set is still used and should not be removed.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing a core CodeSystem/v2-0136 or source/v2 table definition would be inconsistent with the current build and terminology ownership, and current core source already points to the correct external v2 ValueSet/CodeSystem artifacts.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive correction for yesnodontknow's missing CodeSystem/v2-0136 reference; already audited on the combined branch as no-change and supports the current ValueSet/v2-0136 plus CodeSystem/v2-0532 state.
Later request to remove or repair the yesnodontknow example was resolved No Change because the value set is used, supporting retention rather than removal.
